svg.aria-label: The teaching mode of the tutor skill: /tutor <topic>. Boxes: MISSION.md read, when it exists (a step of the session); The mission interview (stop); The confirmation before the mission is changed (stop); Resources found and recorded in RESOURCES.md, while it is not well populated (a step of the session); What the lesson teaches: one tightly scoped thing (a step of the session); The lesson designed around a skill: its knowledge, its task and the task's feedback (a step of the session); The lesson written from the components of assets/, with its reference documents (a step of the session); The lesson opened (a step of the session).
